Vos robots attendent près du hangar. App: Your robots are waiting near the hangar. Walk up to one of them and press {key} to board it: you drive it just like the pilot, and its weapons fire wherever you aim. Hit the targets with it, then press {key} to get out.

Cliquez sur un <b>affût</b> sur l'aperçu: Click a hardpoint on the robot preview, or in the list, then a weapon in the armoury.

A robot that is destroyed, or left outside the extraction circle, is lost along with its cargo. Your new robot is already deployed.
« <b>Réglages</b> », sous chaque carte,: “Settings”, under each card, changes a robot's brain, group and fire mode; “Refit” sends it back to the forge without losing its experience.

Chaque raid se déroule dans un nouveau m: Each raid takes place in a new 12 km² world. The idea: search, then place the anchoring beacon and defend it until extraction. Only what is extracted makes it back to base.
En haut à gauche : l'objectif et l'alert: Top left: the objective and the alert level, which rises over time. Top right: the minimap.
De la ferraille traîne devant vous. Pass: There is scrap lying in front of you. Walk over it: it goes into your pack (top left). The heavier it is, the slower you move. When it is full, your robots with cargo holds take the rest.
There is scrap lying in front of you. Walk over it: it goes into your pack (bottom left). The heavier it is, the slower you move. When it is full, your robots with cargo holds take the rest.
Les caisses contiennent ferraille, circu: Crates contain scrap, circuits, alloy and data. Stand next to the crate and hold {key} until the circle fills, then pick up whatever drops.
Les <b>cristaux</b> violets et les <b>ép: Purple crystals and wrecks can be broken down by shooting: aim and fire at them to knock loose crystals, scrap and alloy, then pick it all up. When the fleet is idle with no enemy in sight, your robots join in too. At the hangar, the Harvester brain makes this its speciality: it even opens crates.

<b>Clic droit</b> sur le marqueur : la s: Right-click the marker: the selection moves there in formation ({key} changes formation). With nothing selected, the whole fleet obeys. Shift + right-click chains waypoints.

Technologies are grouped by family (the tabs at the top) and progress from left to right; silhouettes show what comes next. Choose a technology outlined in orange, for example Ant Chassis, then “Research”. The data they cost comes from crates, pylons and enemies.

Opérations : cinq nouveaux contrats qui: Operations: five new contracts that place their objectives in the world. Escort a convoy to its depot, find and bring back a downed pilot, sabotage an outpost's generators before they lock down, defend a drill against waves of attackers, hunt down a named elite target that keeps moving.
Neuf nouveaux ennemis : Sapeurs kamikaze: Nine new enemies: kamikaze Sappers, Aegis units that shield their neighbours, flying Menders, missile-launching Ravagers, near-invisible Spectres, Flying Nests, Howitzers, and two elites, the Grinder and the Executioner. There are also more enemies in the world.
Deux difficultés de plus, Enfer et Apoca: Two more difficulties, Hell and Apocalypse: each is unlocked by a successful extraction on the previous one.
Robots : les pattes se posent au sol et: Robots: legs plant on the ground and step over as the body moves away, each weapon sits on a visible hardpoint sized to its slot, and heavy weapons make the whole machine recoil.
Le décor garde la trace des combats jusq: The scenery bears the scars of battle until the end of the raid: craters, scorch marks, ground vitrified by the biggest explosions, rubble from toppled walls, debris from destroyed machines. Damaged hulls become covered in scorch marks, then glowing cracks.
Toutes les difficultés : PV, dégâts et r: All difficulties: enemy HP, damage and reinforcements +10%, 15% more reinforcements.
Hell: HP ×2.5, damage ×2.25, loot ×3. Apocalypse: HP ×3.3, damage ×2.8, loot ×4.2.
Une opération rapporte de 1,7 à 1,9 fois: An operation pays 1.7 to 1.9 times as much as a hunting contract and counts double towards the region's reputation.
Affûts gradués : un tiers des affûts d'u: Graded hardpoints: a third of a robot's hardpoints take weapons of its maximum size, the next third one size down, the rest two sizes down. A Colossus carries two titanic weapons, two heavy and two medium. Existing robots are re-armed automatically, and surplus weapons are refunded.
Tous les bâtiments montent jusqu'au nive: All buildings go up to level 10 (contracts office, expedition post and Titanic Shipyard up to level 5): a 300-robot hangar, 6 workers, 5 expeditions at once, cheaper research and giants, much sturdier defences.
Le bureau des contrats, la station radar: The contracts office, radar station, armoured warehouse, laser turret and anti-air tower finally have their own look.
Dézoom : la vue s'arrête au bord de la c: Zooming out: the view stops at the edge of the map instead of showing empty space, the base is surrounded by wasteland, names and prompts no longer overlap, the ground no longer turns into big pixels and clouds fade out when seen from very high up.
La qualité d'image baissée automatiqueme: Image quality that was lowered automatically now goes back up by itself once the device has headroom again.
Les équipes rivales et les renforts fabr: Rival teams and reinforcements built during raids follow the same hardpoint rule.
Attaques de pillards : à partir du QG ni: Raider attacks: from HQ level 6, one more Mastodon per wave (from the very first wave at level 8).
Effet mesuré sur 42 raids simulés jusqu': Effect measured over 42 simulated raids up to tier 4: almost as many successful extractions (29 instead of 31) and 20% more loot, but less resilient fleets: 37% more losses by value.
Terrains retravaillés : les sols se fond: Reworked terrain: ground types blend into one another instead of forming stepped edges; shading is continuous; pebbles, tufts of grass and cracks break up the repetition; walls, ramparts and cliffs cast shadows.
Sauvegardes solides : copie de secours a: Robust saves: automatic backup copy, an unreadable save is set aside instead of being overwritten, and Settings → Save lets you export or import a game (file or code to copy) to switch devices.
Réglages regroupés (affichage, commandes: Settings regrouped (display, controls, sound); 30 frames per second mode to save battery; optional single-tap opening of crates and activation of pylons; resolution that adapts by itself on modest devices.
Les confirmations s'affichent dans le je: Confirmations are shown in-game, and a technical issue log (Settings → About) helps report a problem without the game stopping.
Pendant la fenêtre d'extraction, la flot: During the extraction window, the fleet moves into the circle on its own (except robots holding a position).
Les promotions simultanées tiennent sur: Simultaneous promotions fit on a single line, and terrain chunks are prepared in advance: no more stuttering while moving.
Android : désormais, les mises à jour s': Android: updates now install over the previous version without losing your game.
Signal de la balise : les vagues de fin: Beacon signal: end-of-charge waves are about 25% smaller, grow less with army size and arrive every 14 s instead of 12.
Les robots dans le cercle de la balise s: Robots inside the beacon's circle slowly repair (1.2% of their HP per second).
Balise détruite : la nouvelle reprend 40: Beacon destroyed: the new one recovers 40% of the accumulated charge instead of starting from zero.
Les Cendres ménagent les premières flott: The Ashlands go easier on early fleets: enemy fire 15% weaker and fewer Mastodons around military bases.
Laboratoire niveau 5 (géants, armes colo: Laboratory level 5 (giants, colossal and apocalyptic weapons): Data cost −20%, AI Core cost −25%.
Une IA qui ne se bloque plus: An AI that no longer gets stuck
Les robots calculent un chemin praticabl: Robots plot a passable route, free themselves when they get stuck and no longer shoot into walls.
Le cerveau Récolteur ouvre les caisses e: The Harvester brain opens crates and shoots down crystals and wrecks from range; the Escort also harvests when idle.
Tutoriel à jour, avec une étape « Récolt: Updated tutorial, with a “Harvest by shooting” step.
Nouvelle interface, arbre de recherche p: New interface, research tree by family, interactive forge and gradual discovery of the game.
Géants des rangs 7 à 9, armes colossales: Tier 7 to 9 giants, colossal and apocalyptic weapons, reinforcements built during raids, extended zoom.
Escouades autonomes qui fouillent et s'e: Autonomous squads that search and extract on their own, even when the game is closed; you can follow them live from the base.
Tout ce qui bouge veut votre mort, et il: Everything that moves wants you dead, and it's everywhere. Loot tripled.
Pour les flottes de géants. Chaque extra: For fleets of giants. Every extraction is a feat; the loot matches it.
